title: fix(spec,service-automation)!: QuerySchema.fields and the get_record node's fields refuse an empty projection
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB8Kh2HdiJzzy5dQUrvvTRJa)_

Fixes #27166

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` teaches `fields` and nested `expand` `fields` only as non-empty lists (`skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md`: the nested `expand` value row and the nested-expand example), and teaches the `get_record` node without `fields` (`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`); no file teaches an empty projection, and every taught use stays true.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:最后两份还接受空投影的公开声明——QueryAST 自身的 `QuerySchema.fields`(因而也是每一层 `expand` 条目的值类型)和流程 `get_record` 节点的 `fields`——改为与其余投影声明共用同一条规则:至少一个字段名,且不能为空白。报错文字同一处定义,不复制。
- **为什么改**:#27161 之后引擎在 `find` / `findOne` 入口(顶层与任意层 `expand`)拒绝空投影,而这两份声明仍写着「空也收」:`get_record` 节点写 `fields: []` 能保存,运行时才失败。现在保存时就被拒。
- **风险与回滚**:低。仓内没有任何非测试的作者写这两种空投影;不写 `fields` 仍读全部字段,非空列表不变,类型不变(`string[]`)。附带一处可见变化:`POST /data/:object/query` 请求体里 `fields: []` 由请求体 schema 拒绝(`400 VALIDATION_FAILED`,`query.fields`),与其别名 `$select: []` 的回答一致;此前由 normalizer 拒绝(`400 VALIDATION_ERROR`)。两者都是拒绝,只是错误码变了。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**:`packages/spec/src/data/projection-names-a-field.ts`(共享规则移入的新模块)、`query.zod.ts` 与 `builtin-node-config.zod.ts` 各一行、`packages/spec/src/data/projection-names-a-field.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/projection-names-a-field.test.ts`,预期 28/28 通过;把 `query.zod.ts` 的 `fields` 改回 `z.array(FieldNodeSchema)` 时 15 条失败。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

| Shape | `main` (9dacccf9) | This head |
|---|---|---|
| `QuerySchema.parse({ object, fields: [] })` | parses | refused at `fields`: "Name at least one field" |
| `QuerySchema` with `expand: { rel: { object, fields: [] } }`, any depth | parses | refused at `expand.rel.fields` (or deeper), same words |
| `EngineQueryOptionsSchema` with an `expand` entry's `fields: []` | parses | refused at `expand.rel.fields`, same words |
| `fields: ['name', '']` / `['name', '  ']` on any of the above | parses | refused at `fields.1`: "A field name cannot be blank" |
| `QueryWithTransportSchema` canonical `fields: []` | parses (its `$select: []` alias was already refused) | refused at `fields`, the same message `$select: []` gets |
| `POST /data/:object/query` body `{ "fields": [] }` | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` from the normalizer (on 18.2.0: `200`, every column) | `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` at `query.fields` from the body schema, as `$select` / `select` |
| `POST /data/:object/query` body `{ "expand": { "owner": { "object": "sys_user", "fields": [] } } }` | `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` from the engine door (on 18.2.0: `200`, every column of the related record) | `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` at `query.expand.owner.fields` from the body schema |
| `GetRecordConfigSchema` `fields: []` | parses | refused at `fields`, same words |
| a flow `get_record` node with `fields: []` | saves; run fails with the engine's refusal | `defineStack` refuses it with `422 STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` at `flows.0.nodes.1.config.fields`; the save door's node judge (`flowNodeConfigRefusals`) refuses it at `fields`; the executor refuses the config before any read |
| `fields` absent, or a non-empty list | parses | unchanged |

- **One declaration, not a copy.** `PROJECTION_NAMES_NO_FIELD` and `transportProjectionArray` move from `data-engine.zod.ts` into the new `packages/spec/src/data/projection-names-a-field.ts`. They had to move: `data-engine.zod.ts` imports `query.zod.ts`, so `query.zod.ts` could not read them where they were. The module stays outside the `data` barrel, so no public export is added (as with `filter-save-door-refusals.ts`). `data-engine.zod.ts` imports both names and keeps its string arm and its docblock; the docblock gains one paragraph that says where the array arm now lives and why.
- `BaseQuerySchema.fields` becomes `transportProjectionArray(FieldNodeSchema)`, the construction `EngineQueryOptionsSchema.fields` and `QueryTransportParamsSchema.$select` already use. `QuerySchema` is one declaration, so this also covers its top level (the driver tuple inputs, the API contract input, the canonical `fields` of `QueryWithTransportSchema`) and every nested `expand` value. Seat 1 ruled for narrowing the base declaration rather than an expand-only copy of the recursive schema.
- `GetRecordConfigSchema.fields` becomes `transportProjectionArray(z.string())`.
- Both `.describe()` texts now say that an empty list or a blank name is refused and that omitting `fields` reads every field. The five reference pages that render them are regenerated (`gen:docs`).
- `@objectstack/service-automation`: the `get_record` designer form declares `fields` with `minItems: 1`, the way its `limit` mirrors the contract's floor, so the form no longer offers an empty list the save refuses. `builtin-node-form-zod-ledger.test.ts` pins both sides at that boundary, beside the `limit` pin.
- ADR-0087: `registered query-and-get-record-empty-projection-refused`, a new step-18 D3 semantic entry. There is no D2 conversion: the only mechanical rewrite of `fields: []` is to drop the key, which reads every column, and that is the widening the rule refuses. Stored flows are not rewritten.
- Changeset `.changeset/27166-query-get-record-empty-projection.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor and `@objectstack/service-automation` minor (`Metadata-protocol: narrowed` takes `minor` on each package whose `src/**` the diff moves), with both declaration lines, the `Skills-docs:` line, the ADR-0087 marker and a BREAKING banner with Before / Now / Unchanged and the remedy.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/queries.mdx`: the empty-projection sentence names each refusal point (`4dbe7883`). A POST body is refused by the schema (`VALIDATION_FAILED` at `query.fields`); the querystring forms (`?fields=`, `$select=`) keep `VALIDATION_ERROR`; `engine.find` in-process refuses it; a `get_record` node is refused when the flow is saved.
- **The changeset is anchored to `@objectstack/spec@18.2.0`.** Its **Before** now describes the last release: there, a `get_record` node with `fields: []` saved, registered and ran, reading every column, and a REST POST with `fields: []` answered `200`. #26644 and #27008 are in the same unreleased batch. The changeset also names the stored-flow consequence: such a flow is refused by `registerFlow` on every pull, and it stays unregistered with its triggers unbound until the row is edited. `os migrate meta --stored` has no conversion to apply to it. It also carries a **Supersedes, in the same release:** paragraph for the `26954-engine-projection-empty.md` sentence that says `engine.find(object, { fields: [] })` still reads every column, which #27008 made false; the precedent is `25923-calendar-gantt-flat-fallback-retired.md`. The D3 entry's `reason` and `acceptanceCriteria` say the same.
- `data-empty-projection-count-door.test.ts` gains the `expand` row: the test checks for `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` and `fields[0].field = query.expand.owner.fields`, and that the object was never read.

## Why

#26954 (PR #27007) made the engine-side projection declarations refuse `[]`. #27008 (PR #27161) made the in-process engine refuse it at the `find` / `findOne` entry, top level and on every `expand` entry. Its acceptance notes reported two declarations still admitting it: the QueryAST's `fields`, which is the value type of `EngineQueryOptionsSchema.expand`, and `GetRecordConfigSchema.fields`, which the `get_record` executor hands to `data.find` / `findOne` as written. So the runtime refused shapes these declarations admitted, and a `get_record` node with `fields: []` was caught at run instead of at save. Triage 6466002857 set the lane to `domain:spec`.

## Readers and producers (measured on `origin/main` 9dacccf9)

- **Who parses these shapes at run time.**
  - The `get_record` executor parses its config with `GetRecordConfigSchema` (`crud-nodes.ts`, `parseNodeConfig`).
  - `defineStack` / `os validate` and `registerFlow` judge every builtin node config through `flowNodeConfigRefusals`.
  - The REST body schema (`FindDataRequestSchema.query` = `QueryWithTransportSchema`) extends `QuerySchema`'s shape, so its canonical `fields` narrows too.
  - No code outside `packages/spec` parses `QuerySchema` itself, nor the driver tuple inputs.
- **Census of authored empty projections on the two shapes.** I ran `git grep` over `packages`, `ui`, `examples`, `apps` and `skills`.
  - One hit: `get-record-id-projection.integration.test.ts:167`, the #27161 test that pinned the run-time refusal. It now pins the config refusal: the engine is never asked, and the node fails with `config.fields: Name at least one field.`
  - Two other tests pinned the old acceptance and are rewritten. `query.test.ts` ("should handle empty arrays") drops `fields: []` and points at the new file. `data-empty-projection-count-door.test.ts` moves its `fields: []` row from the normalizer table to the body-schema table and adds a blank-member row.
  - No `examples/**` or non-test source authors either shape empty.
- **The designer UI.** `ui/` offers no `fields` input for `get_record` (`flow-node-config.ts` has `objectName`, `filter`, `limit`, `outputVariable`), so no `ui/` change is needed.
- **Types.** `z.input` / `z.infer` stay `string[]`. `typecheck` exits 0 for spec, service-automation and rest.
- **JSON Schema.** `fields` gains `minItems: 1` and a non-blank `pattern` on each item. `check:generated` reported only the reference pages stale, and they are regenerated.

## Verification

All at head `939accc9` unless a line says otherwise.

**Round 2, on the merged tree (`a1b4b045`, merge `295699d5`)**, all exit 0: `check:generated`; spec `src/data` + `src/automation` + `src/migrations` (189 files, 6392 passed); spec typecheck; service-automation `src/builtin` (82 files, 1154 passed); the three rest files (120 passed); `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`.

<details><summary>New pins and ablation</summary>

`packages/spec/src/data/projection-names-a-field.test.ts` has 28 cases:
- `QuerySchema` refuses `[]`, `['name', '']` and `['name', '  ']` at the top level, on an `expand` entry and on a second-level `expand` entry. Each refusal asserts the path and the message `EngineQueryOptionsSchema.fields` gives for the same value.
- `EngineQueryOptionsSchema.expand` refuses the same values on an entry.
- `QueryWithTransportSchema`'s canonical `fields` refuses them with `$select`'s message.
- `GetRecordConfigSchema` refuses them. The save door's node judge refuses them at `fields` / `fields[1]`. `defineStack` refuses a flow whose `get_record` node carries `fields: []` with `422 STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` at `flows.0.nodes.1.config.fields`.
- Controls: one or two names parse unchanged, and absent `fields` parses unchanged, on every shape.

Ablation after commit, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0; restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty):
- `query.zod.ts` `fields` reverted to `z.array(FieldNodeSchema)`: 15 failed / 13 passed. These are the five `QuerySchema` / `expand` / transport groups.
- `builtin-node-config.zod.ts` `fields` reverted to `z.array(z.string())`: 7 failed / 21 passed. These are the three contract refusals, the three node-judge refusals and the `defineStack` case.
</details>

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && check:generated`: only `content/docs/references/**` was stale. `gen:docs` was run and the result committed.
- `@objectstack/spec` full suite, at `bd35a3fa` under the lock: 823 files, 23598 passed, 1 failed (`query.test.ts` "should handle empty arrays", the old acceptance pin, rewritten in the next commit; that file is then 91/91). `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `@objectstack/service-automation` build, suite and typecheck, at `bd35a3fa`: 216 files, 2756 passed, 1 failed (the rewritten get_record pin, whose expected path read `fields:` where the executor prints `config.fields:`; fixed in the next commit, and that file plus the form ledger are then 17/17). `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `@objectstack/rest` suite: 338 files passed, 6835 tests passed, 344 skipped.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` suite: 277 files passed, 4 skipped; 21750 tests passed, 26 skipped.
- Full dogfood, owed by the `(narrowing)` arm, after the `@objectstack/dogfood^...` closure build: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock, no shard, no path: Test Files 348 passed | 3 skipped (351); Tests 2804 passed | 20 skipped (2824); exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 109 commands, all run serially at this head. 107 exited 0 on the first pass, including `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` (`registered query-and-get-record-empty-projection-refused (new here)`), `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main` and `spec check:generated` (14/14 up to date). Two exited 3 because their prerequisite was not met: `spec check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. They read built output. After I built the seven packages whose `dist` they named, both exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "109 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 107 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)", and those two then ran green. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` ran after fetching its pinned fixture commit. Also `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 11 changed `.ts` files: exit 0. `@objectstack/rest` `typecheck`: exit 0.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The REST code change is deliberate and is the ruling's consequence.** A `POST /data/:object/query` body with `fields: []` was refused before and is refused now. The code moves from `VALIDATION_ERROR` (normalizer) to `VALIDATION_FAILED` (body schema), and the refusal now names `query.fields`, as it already did for `select` / `$select`. The querystring spellings (`?fields=`, `?$select=`) are unchanged: they go through the normalizer as before.
- **The in-process engine already refused these shapes** (#27161). This diff changes no runtime source except the designer form's `minItems`.
- **`main` was merged (merge commit, no rebase) at `295699d5`.** Main had moved `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` and `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`, in hunks that do not overlap this diff. `protocol.mdx` is a generated artifact, so it was regenerated on the merged tree (`gen:schema && gen:docs`) in its own commit, not text-merged. After the merge, the PR's delta against `main` is 19 files: the 18 above, plus `packages/runtime/src/domains/data-empty-projection-count.test.ts` (`c483a00e`). The runtime dispatcher's door moves the same way as REST. Its POST body `{ "fields": [] }` row moves from the normalizer table to the file's schema table and expects `VALIDATION_FAILED` at `query.fields`, next to the blank-member and `expand` rows, mirroring the rest pin. That row had turned Test Core 3/8 red on `4dbe7883`.
- **Stored flows are not rewritten.** A stored flow whose `get_record` node carries `fields: []` already failed at run on `main`. It now also meets the refusal where a flow is registered or saved. The D3 entry tells authors to sweep for it.

## Human Minimum

Each item is one rule from
[CONTRIBUTING.md › Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum),
which links the AGENTS.md text that states it.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran. `eslint --no-inline-config` over every changed `.ts` file exits 0; the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/` (the reference pages are `gen:docs` output).
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
